provisional_leads.event_type: journalists’ sit-in/vigil protesting killing of journalist Amal Khalil
provisional_leads.actors: Dozens of journalists; Lebanese Order of Press Editors representative

sources.title: “Her last report led to her death”: Sit-in in Beirut honors journalist Amal Khalil
sources.excerpt: dozens of journalists gathered Tuesday in front of the Escwa headquarters in Beirut
sources.provenance: L’Orient Today, opened accessible public article, by staff; reports event directly, with eyewitness correspondent and a photograph dated April 28.

provisional_leads.assessment: Accessible local reporting establishes an April 28 journalists’ sit-in, and Reuters Connect documents a distinct April 23 vigil.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: These actions were prompted by the killing during the Israel–Hezbollah conflict; this discovery pass records the civic gatherings, not the armed conflict.

sources.title: Vigil to condemn the killing of journalists, in Beirut

sources.provenance: Reuters Connect public image caption; identifies April 23 vigil in Martyrs’ Square after Amal Khalil was killed April 22.

provisional_leads.assessment: Publicly accessible Reuters caption specifies event date and location.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: Image caption provides limited details about organizers, turnout and demands.
